description: If \(\operatorname{unify}(P)\) returns \(\mu\), then \(\mu\) unifies every equation in \(P\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.unify_sound.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (P : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Problem L)
  (μ : ℕ → L.Term ℕ) (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.unify P = some μ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Unifies μ P
